title: rules-toggle state (v1)
description: Per-consumer rules toggle state. Single source of truth at <project>/.ai-playbook/rules-toggle.json (gitignored). Sparse representation: only entries that diverge from the all-ON default are present; rules absent from `rules{}` are assumed ON in every layer. Read/written by scripts/rules_toggle.py and scripts/apply_config.py. Forward-compatible additions land as v2.

applied_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last write. Optional but recommended for audit clarity.

applied_by.description: Identifier of the agent/user that last wrote the file. Sourced from `$USER`/`$USERNAME` by the CLI; bundle imports may set explicitly.

rules.description: Map of rule-slug -> per-rule override. Rules absent from this map default to fully ON.

enabled.description: Master switch for this rule. When false, all layers (L1/L2/L3) are skipped regardless of `layers` entries below; the rule emits telemetry `block_class=rule_disabled` and exits 0.

layers.description: Per-layer override. A missing layer key inherits from `enabled`. Use to disable a single layer (e.g. L3 in CI) while keeping the others active.

L1.description: PreToolUse hook + rule.py wrapper. False disables them.

L2.description: Sandwich-defense reinforcement (markdown rule visible to the model). False mutes the L2 surface.

L3.description: GitHub Actions workflow validation. False causes the workflow step to skip via the `rules_toggle status --exit-code` gate.

advanced.description: Per-rule advanced sub-toggles (e.g. {bash_inspection: false} for apply-skill-enforcement). Keys come from the rule's `advanced[]` entry in tools/config-ui/rules-inventory.json; values project to env vars in .ai-playbook/feature-flags.env via the inventory mapping.

reason.description: Human-readable justification for the override. Required when disabling a rule whose inventory entry carries `break_glass_env` (enforced by scripts/rules_toggle.py, not the schema).

disabled_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the rule was last disabled. Cleared when the rule is re-enabled.

ttl_days.description: Reserved for v2 auto-restore. v1 ignores this field; manual re-enable required.
